title: Chapter 14: Dual Territories Of Light And Darkness
content:
Chapter 14: Dual Territories Of Light And Darkness

In the slightly luxurious hall of the lord's castle in the city, the atmosphere was not as relaxing as others imagined.

There were only Wu Qing, the kobold lord and an old kobold man in the hall.

The kobolds could tell that the Zerg tribe was dominated by Wu Qing, so they only invited Wu Qing into the hall.

The old kobold man is a strong man. From Wu Qing's perspective, his strength may have reached the star level in this world, which is one star.

This is the first star-level person Wu Qing has met.

This kobold's age is so obvious that it's easy to tell that he is an old man.

"Wu Qing, the current situation is very bad. This place will soon become the front line. You have eliminated so many evil god believers at once, which must have attracted their attention!"

"The reinforcements from the Evil God's followers will arrive soon!"

When he arrived here, the young kobold lord no longer pretended to be a lord, his true nature was exposed, and his anxiety was undisguised.

"Facing the reinforcements of the evil god's followers, my small territory must have no hope at all!"

"I'll be leaving soon!"

"Originally, I wanted to leave, but I felt very unwilling to leave so many people to the evil god!"

"I heard about you and the Zerg yesterday. I think you should be able to stop the army of followers of the evil god. I invite you here this time just to transfer this territory to you!"

"What do you think?"

The kobold lord finished speaking in one breath, making the old kobold man beside him shake his head.

Wu Qing was also a little surprised. It turned out that this kobold lord was really a second-rate man and had no appearance of being a superior person at all.

"I don't know much about the lord. Can the territory be transferred directly?"

Now that you have met someone who is easy to talk to, you should ask more questions about things you don’t know.

"Of course. The power of the lord is conferred by the lord's scepter. It is not easy to unbind the lord's scepter from the territory. But to transfer the territory, you only need to hand over the lord's scepter. It is very simple!"

The kobold lord said, raising the scepter in his hand.

"Actually, we can still handle the reinforcements from the followers of the evil god. You can continue to be your lord."

Wu Qing used retreat to advance.

There is no such thing as pie in the sky. Although he is not afraid, it is always good to know more about the situation.

"You have no idea how powerful the evil god's army is!"

"Forget it, I know you have confidence. I'm tired of being this lord, so I feel relieved if I leave it to you. Just ask if you want it!"

The kobold lord seemed a little impatient.

"No problem, we can accept this territory. What are the conditions of the lord?"

Wu Qing is very curious about the lords of this world. Now that he has the opportunity, he will definitely give it a try, regardless of whether there is something fishy about it.

"As for the conditions, when you asked, I remembered one thing. The piece of equipment you gave to the Fox Clan looks pretty good. Give me one too!"

The kobold lord pretended to think about it and made this request.

Wu Qing laughed dumbly. It turned out that the lord had this little idea, which coincided with his idea.

"The lord is talking about biological reproductive equipment, right? Although this equipment is precious, it is just right to give one to the lord as a gift when we meet for the first time."

"I want my Zerg companions to go back and get one."

Wu Qing readily agreed to the kobold lord's request.

"Then you have to hurry up! I really want to leave here right away, I don't want to stay any longer!"

the kobold lord urged.

Wu Qing pretended to call a puppy and showed off.

In the Zerg territory, Wu Qing spent 100 points of energy and 50 points of Qi to produce a biological breeding suit. A puppy came to pick it up and delivered it to him.

"Lord, please rest assured, the distance is not far and we will be there soon."

Wu Qing looked at the restless kobold lord and comforted him.

The old kobold man remained silent.

Wu Qing just pretended that he didn't exist.

"Take the lord's scepter! I have released the binding!"

The kobold lord raised his scepter, sat motionless, and signaled Wu Qing to go and get it.

Wu Qing smiled and didn't care about the behavior of this useless lord. He stood up, walked over, and picked up the scepter that represented the qualifications of the world lord.

As soon as he touched the lord's scepter, some information was passed over. Wu Qing ignored it and went back to sit down again.

"When you get the lord's scepter, you will naturally know how to become a lord. This scepter has been bound to the Red Earth Territory. Don't take the scepter out of the territory of the Red Earth Territory easily!"

"Thank you Lord for the reminder!"

The three of them were relatively speechless.

Not long after, the puppy's reproductive equipment was delivered.

Wu Qing took the biological reproductive equipment and took the initiative to send it to the kobold lord.

This time the kobold lord stood up, picked up the biological reproductive suit with satisfaction, said: "See you later!", and hurried away with his people.

Outside was the kobold guard that had been prepared long ago, all riding large lizards. When the kobold lord came out, they escorted him out of the castle and quickly left the city.

The lord of the Red Earth Territory ran away, leaving aside the impact on the people in the entire territory. Wu Qing, who was in the castle, quickly discovered the first huge pit through the message delivered by the lord's scepter.

"No wonder he ran so fast."

"She's quite cute and looks very honest, but a little dishonest."

Wu Qing thought that he had just been in the same room with two Chinese pastoral dogs with human bodies, and they felt that it was a little unreal.

For this Lord's Staff, the Dog-headed Lord did not explain a very important issue. This staff is a subsidiary Lord's Staff of a large territory.

Binding this Lord's Staff will make you a subsidiary Lord of a large territory. Not only will the Lord's power be limited, but the territory's luck will also be extracted, which is equivalent to working for someone on a voluntary basis.

Ordinary people will not bind such a Lord's Staff. Only Lords like the evil god believers will use the power of the gods to forcibly devour the staff and gain certain benefits.

However, Wu Qing was not too angry. He was a person with a system.

Sure enough, after understanding the Lord's Staff, the system prompts appeared immediately.

Discover the embodiment of the world rules.

Analyze the world rules.

Integrate the world rules.

Update the Zerg base settings.

Generate the Lord's Staff and open the world lord authority.

A few lines of prompts from the system made all calculations fall through.

Wu Qing obtained a brand new Lord's Staff, which not only bound the territory of the Red Earth Territory, but also secretly bound the territory of the Zerg.

The two territories are one bright and one dark, and they are integrated. Their luck and resources are interconnected and complement each other.

"The fun game has just begun. We will meet again soon."

Wu Qing looked at the direction where the dog-headed man left and said with a smile.

"Brother Wu! Why did the lord leave suddenly?"

Hu Tu, who found something wrong, rushed in.
